get_config: get the default MD4 training config for CIFAR10 with dataset, model, and training hyperparameters
sweep: run a hyperparameter sweep on MD4 CIFAR10 training with varying noise_schedule and sampling_grid settings
create_config_dict: create a ml_collections ConfigDict for MD4 CIFAR10 training with dataset shape, timesteps, and sampler settings
build_training_config: build a training config for MD4 on CIFAR10 with learning rate, batch size, and checkpoint schedule
review_sweep: review the sweep function that launches multiple work units with varying noise_schedule and sampling_grid
